title: Enhancing Bayesian Optimization and Active Learning Through Kernel Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2608.24721v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperparameter selection remains a key challenge in Bayesian optimization (BO) and Bayesian active learning (AL), as model misspecification can lead to suboptimal performance, while more accurate fully Bayesian treatments typically rely on computationally expensive MCMC sampling. This paper proposes a unified framework, KENDO (Kernel ENsemble Disagreement-aware Operator), that integrates Ensemble Gaussian Processes (EGP) with disagreement-aware acquisition strategies. The central idea is to replace hyperparameter sampling with a kernel ensemble and adaptive Bayesian weighting, combined with disagreement-aware acquisition strategies. Within this unified framework, we instantiate KENDO-BO for BO and KENDO-AL for Bayesian AL, demonstrating that both arise from a common self-correcting mechanism with task-specific acquisition objectives. translated_title: 通过核多样性增强贝叶斯优化与主动学习
translated_abstract: 超参数选择仍然是贝叶斯优化（BO）和贝叶斯主动学习（AL）中的关键挑战，因为模型误设可能导致性能次优，而更精确的全贝叶斯处理方法通常依赖于计算成本高昂的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样。本文提出了一个统一框架KENDO（核集成分歧感知算子），该框架将集成高斯过程（EGP）与分歧感知获取策略相结合。核心思想是用核集成和自适应贝叶斯权重替代超参数采样，并结合分歧感知获取策略。在此统一框架内，我们实例化了用于BO的KENDO-BO和用于贝叶斯AL的KENDO-AL，展示了两者均源自具有任务特定获取目标的共同自校正机制。我们进一步通过保留随机标量化方法将该方法扩展到多目标优化。
tldr: 本文提出KENDO统一框架，通过核集成和自适应贝叶斯权重替代超参数采样，结合分歧感知策略，同时提升贝叶斯优化和主动学习的性能，并扩展到多目标优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified KENDO framework that replaces hyperparameter sampling with kernel ensembles and adaptive Bayesian weighting, combined with disagreement-aware strategies, to enhance both Bayesian optimization and active learning, with extension to multi-objective optimization.
